data.title: Greetings & Conversation — Starter · Lesson 4
data.subject: greetings
data.lyrics:
¡Dale!

[Hook]
Hello… Hola  
How's it going?… ¿Qué tal?  
Let's talk, let's walk, let's go  
One step, two steps, let's flow  
Meeting new friends today

[Verse]
Sun's up, skies are blue  
Walking up, saying "Hi… Hola" to you  
Greetings… Saludos, that's the word  
Excuse me… Disculpa, if it's unheard  
Nice to meet you… Encantado, I say  
Where are you from?… ¿De dónde eres?  
Fine… Bien, I'm doing great  
Take care… Cuídate, have a lovely day  

[Hook]  
Hello… Hola  
How's it going?… ¿Qué tal?  
Let's talk, let's walk, let's go  
One step, two steps, let's flow  
Meeting new friends today  

[Verse]  
Good morning… Buenos días, the sun's shining bright  
I'm from here… De aquí, and it's a beautiful sight  
See you soon… Hasta pronto, that's what we say  
Thank you… Gracias, and you're welcome… De nada, every day  
What's your name?… ¿Cómo te llamas? I ask with a grin  
Friendly vibes… Buenas ondas, let the fun begin  

[Bridge]  
Walking through the neighborhood
